evidence.quote: All courses are taught in English. The Bachelor's thesis must be written in English.
Applications for this programme are submitted via uni-assist.

notes: The tuition fact uses the quote 'A study at the Koblenz University of Applied Sciences is free of tuition.'; this is an institution-wide statement that may not apply to all applicants, especially those from outside the EU/EEA. The intakes fact has two entries because the page lists both winter and summer periods, but all three dates are null so the fact should be rejected per rules. The language_proficiency rule for English lists only TOEFL as an accepted test because the quote mentions TOEFL; it also mentions Cambridge English but the quote does not include it in the same sentence. Application channel: 'Applications for this programme are submitted via uni-assist' indicates de-uni-assist; no mention of VPD or direct university application.

evidence.quote: you must also provide proof of English language proficiency at level C1 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR)
TOEFL: TOEFL iBT (95-120 points) or TOEFL PBT (627-677 points)
